top_signals.title: India’s RBI Clarifies Scope of Forex Curbs After Market Swings
top_signals.summary: India’s central bank said its recent derivative restrictions will only apply to deals for hedging forex risk and not for market-making, providing a clarification after sharp swings in currency forward markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
